releaseNotes:
📋 Event Types in Dropdown Manager work again — accidental "Eng" removed, and all your custom types stay visible
➕ Adding an event type from the enquiry form saves the same way as the manager
📌 Sent WhatsApp follow-ups leave the Follow Up tab (with Undo)
⚡ Location search is faster — spinner while searching, quicker first results
✏️ Names like "priya sharma" save as "Priya Sharma"
🔔 New-enquiry pushes show "Corporate Event", not "corporate_event"
🌐 Website contact-form enquiries land in the app
features: FIXED: Dropdown Manager → Event Types shows the full list again (Wedding, Birthday, custom types, …)
IMPROVED: + Add event type from the enquiry form writes items/{value} like the manager
IMPROVED: Follow Up tab hides an enquiry once the WhatsApp follow-up is sent — Undo brings it back
FASTER: Location / Maps search with warm-up, cache and a searching spinner
NEW: Customer and team names are capitalised on save (McKenzie stays McKenzie)
IMPROVED: Push notifications use the readable event type label
NEW: Website contact-form leads create enquiries in the app
bugFixes: Fixed Event Types list going empty after adding a type from the form
Fixed and removed the accidental "Eng" event type
Fixed sent follow-ups staying in the Follow Up list forever
Fixed slow first Maps suggestion after opening the form
Fixed notification bodies showing corporate_event instead of Corporate Event
